title: Three-minute energiser
intro: A bit more get-up-and-go, all low impact. Keep it comfortable, not hard.

moves.name: Warm up the shoulders
steps: Roll your shoulders back in big, easy circles.

moves.name: Big arm circles
steps: Hold your arms out to the sides.
Draw wide, slow circles, forward and then backward.

moves.name: March in place
steps: Lift your knees at an easy height.

moves.name: Reach and sweep
steps: Reach one arm across your body, then sweep it out wide.
Alternate arms in an easy rhythm.
Let your hips follow a little.

moves.name: Gentle squats
steps: Hold the desk or a chair back if you like.
Bend your knees as if about to sit, only partway.
Stand back up with a steady breath.

moves.name: Shake it all out
steps: Shake your hands, then your arms, then your shoulders.
Let your head and neck stay loose.
Bounce gently through your knees if you like, keeping both feet on the floor.

moves.name: Slow finish
steps: Take three slow breaths, in through the nose and out through the mouth.

closing: That is the energiser. Take a drink of water if you fancy one.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
